claims.claim: For engine seatng and engines mouthing
claims.evidence: Witness report shows assorted car suspension/engine mount parts and brackets consistent with engine mounting components.
No photos show origin documents, shipping labels, or markings indicating Belgium/tokunbo.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: Witness photos show mixed used-looking parts with rust/aged rubber and no complete assembly; photos cannot confirm testing, mileage, or whether anything was opened.

risks.risk: Wrong vehicle fitment (unknown make/model/position), leading to unusable parts
risks.proof: A clear photo of any part numbers/markings plus a photo showing the exact application/fitment list (or the vehicle it came from) and/or a tape measure with bolt-hole spacing for each mount.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as assorted, compatibility-unknown used suspension/engine mount parts (worst-case: many pieces may not fit).

risks.risk: Rubber mounts/bushings are cracked, torn, or hardened beyond repair
risks.proof: Close-up clips of each rubber bushing/mount showing cracks/tears and the rubber condition (press test video if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/aged used mounts with potential replacement needed (worst-case: only metal brackets usable).

risks.risk: Missing hardware or incomplete sets (bolts, brackets, plates) so installation is not possible
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo with counts and a photo of all included bolts/hardware; show each mount with its matching bracket/plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/assorted components without guaranteed full hardware.

risks.risk: Seized/failed pivot/bolt areas or internal wear (if any moving joints exist)
risks.proof: A short video showing the pivot/bolt area movement (or lack of it) and close-up of any bearing surfaces/threads.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially seized/failed components (worst-case: non-functional).

risks.risk: Condition is worse than implied (rusted metal, greasy/dusty surfaces may indicate corrosion or prior damage)
risks.proof: Clean close-up photos after wiping off grease/dust, focusing on rust depth, cracks in metal arms, and weld/pivot areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as visibly used with corrosion risk.

proof_requests: Provide close-up photos of any part numbers/markings on each mount/bracket (and where they are located).
Show the exact vehicle make/model/year these mounts fit (or a compatibility list) and take photos of the mounts laid out by position.
Give a full inventory count of usable pieces and confirm whether any bolts/hardware are included (photo of all hardware together).
Record short videos/close-ups of the rubber condition (showing cracks/tears) and any pivot/bolt areas for movement or seizure.
If claiming “tested/no knock/low mileage,” show the test evidence (e.g., video of the engine/mount installed and running, or a diagnostic/test sheet).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as assorted used car suspension/engine mount parts, so it can be priced at the worst-case for compatibility and condition. Seller claims about testing, mileage, and origin are not verifiable from the provided report.
